memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them. - Gen 1:27 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
This verse is written almost like poetry, and for good reason, it is a moment of great significance. Three times it repeats that God created mankind, and twice it declares that we are made in His image. The Bible is pressing this truth deep into our hearts: human beings are the special creation of God, made to bear His likeness. Notice too the strong word "created," the same word used for the making of the heavens in verse 1. Only God can do this.

Then comes a beautiful phrase: "male and female he created them." Both men and women, equally and fully, bear the image of God. Neither is above the other in worth or dignity. From the very beginning, God made humanity as male and female, each reflecting Him, each precious in His sight. This is God's good and intentional design, not an accident of nature.

There is deep comfort here. Whoever you are, man or woman, young or old, you carry the image of God. Your value does not come from your achievements, your appearance, or what others say about you. It comes from the God who made you in His likeness.

Sin has damaged that image, but it is being restored in Christ, who is the true image of God (2 Cor 4:4). As we come to Him, we are being made new. Rest today in this truth: you are wonderfully and purposefully made by God.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you truly believe your worth comes from being made in God's image, not from your performance?
2. How can you honour God's design in the way you view men and women around you?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You for creating me in Your image, male and female alike bearing Your likeness. Help me find my worth in You and honour Your good design. Amen.
